name: fruit-name-initialization
description: Initial fruit names handle plural, attribute, monster-food, numeric, and buffer-boundary cases.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Wielder,role:Wizard,race:human,gender:male,align:neutral,playmode:debug
OPTIONS=!autopickup,!legacy,!tutorial,!tips,pettype:none,!safe_wait,!debug_mongen,pauper,nudist
OPTIONS=suppress_alert:3.4.3
OPTIONS=symset:DECgraphics
OPTIONS=paranoid_confirmation:none
OPTIONS=disclose:-i -a -v -g -c -o
OPTIONS=!tombstone
OPTIONS=fruit:apple
segments.name: initial-fruit-0
